about: The suppress-reason rule, one mutant per piece: a literal return counted as silent (`return []` and `return -1`, not only constants), a reason not excusing a blind catch, what ruff already reports not counted twice, a reason scoped to the handler's own span, and contextlib.suppress seen at all. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE jpcheck/suppressions.py tests/test_check_suppress_reason.py tests/mutants/jpt-suppress-reason-on-suppressions.json

mutants.name: a literal return is not silent (constants only)
mutants.target: a handler that only does return an empty list is flagged

mutants.name: a reason excuses a blind catch
edits: if e["ruffs"] or (e["reason"] and not e["blind"]):
mutants.target: except Exception returning a default, with a reason

mutants.name: a bare except-pass is counted here as well as by ruff
edits:
"ruffs": (pass_only and (blind or len(node.body) == 1)
                      and h.lineno not in (hushed or set())),
mutants.target: a bare except: pass is S110's

mutants.name: a reason above the try reaches the handler
mutants.target: a reason ABOVE the try does not reach the handler

mutants.name: contextlib.suppress is not seen
